classification.difficultyReason: Convert fortnightly pay to weekly pay and distinguish exceeding it from merely matching it.

content.prompt:
Russell and Gabrielle go to work in different department stores.
Russell is paid \$1900 per fortnight. Gabrielle is paid \$26.36 per hour.
How many hours per week must Gabrielle work to earn more money than Russell? Give the minimum number of hours in increments of 0.01 hour.

answer.short: 36.04 hours per week; the exact threshold is $h>\frac{23750}{659}$ hours.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Russell's weekly pay}&=\frac{\$1900}{2}\\\text{Russell's weekly pay}&=\$950\\\text{Matching hours}&=\frac{950}{26.36}\\\text{Matching hours}&=\frac{23750}{659}\end{align*}$$
Gabrielle must work more than $\frac{23750}{659}$ hours, approximately $36.03945$ hours. The minimum in increments of $0.01$ hour is $36.04$ hours.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Pay for 36.04 hours}&=\$26.36\times36.04\\\text{Pay for 36.04 hours}&=\$950.0144\end{align*}$$
This exceeds \$950.
